newsitem.title: CHINA: China to standardise treasury bond market.
newsitem.headline: China to standardise treasury bond market.

text.p: China will improve its treasury bond market, issuing short-term discount bonds through uniform price bids while coupon bonds will be floated through multi-price yield bids, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.

"China will continue to standardise the market-oriented tender approach in government bond floating," it quoted Gao Jian, director of the State Debt Management Department of the Ministry of Finance, as saying.
Both multi-price bids and uniform-price tenders will be used, with the size to be based on market demand, he said.
The existing quotation subscription and bidding system will be replaced by competitive or non-competitive bidding, he said.
Open bidding would be tried when necessary, he said.
Measures will also be taken to reduce the cost to individual investors of opening a bond investment account to allow them to buy certificate bonds more easily, he said.
China should establish special funds for individual treasury bond investment as soon as possible, Gao said, adding that China would issue debt more regularly to increase predictability.
Gao said China would unify the treasury bond registration, settlement, and clearance system this year.
